_comment: Stage-2 main campaign: the three-way comparison DoQ / ODoQ / ODoH, with ODoH over both HTTP/3 (QUIC) and HTTP/2 (TLS/TCP). Same blocked randomization, profiles and sample sizes as stage1_main. odoq-per-query and odoq-legacy are not repeated (stage1 data covers them). odoh-h2 has no resume cells: Python's ssl has no TLS early data, so resumption saves no round trips over TCP. Sizes match the stage1_main run actually executed on the measurement server (15 queries/domain, 5 ms gap, 3 reps, lan/rtt50/rtt100/rtt50_loss5), so the two campaigns are directly comparable.
name: stage2_main
